description: Revisions issued under Level 2 guidance procedures (21 CFR 10.115(g)(4)), including revisions to align with the amendments to 21 CFR 820 (the Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR)). This guidance supersedes the final guidance titled “Cybersecurity in Medical Devices: Quality System Considerations and Content of Premarket Submissions” and published June 2025.
